title: Supported structure maps are eventually killed by Koszul augmentations
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, X=Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme], r a natural number, and f:Fin(r)→A. Let U be the union of the principal opens D(f_i). Use the shared derived category of modules on X and its localized site over U [def-pc-derived-category]. Let E belong to D_QCoh(O_X), with zero restriction to U. For the Koszul tail power system [def-sc-koszul-open-system], write I_e, O and u_e:I_e→O for its derived tail, structure object and augmentation, where index e means exponent e+1. For every integer n and every morphism φ:O[n]→E, there exists a natural number e for which u_e[n] followed by φ is zero. No orthogonality, regularity, nonzero-ring or nonempty-family hypothesis is made.

source.place: Equation 36.9.4.1 (Tag 08DC), Proposition 36.9.5 (Tag 08DD), and Lemma 36.15.2 (Tag 09IR), supported-object reduction

proof.text: Move source shift n to target shift -n. The resulting target still has quasi-coherent cohomology and zero restriction. Apply the canonical Koszul Hom colimit comparison of lem-sc-affine-perfect-open-represent-cohomology. Restriction followed by the inverse restricted augmentation sends the index-zero element u_0 composed with φ to zero because the restricted target is zero. The comparison is a colimit cocone, so this element equals the zero element in that colimit. For arbitrary universes, first choose standard localizations and represent E by a complex; transport Hom via uniqueness of localization and transport restriction via mapDerivedCategoryFactors. Compose restriction with Scheme.Modules.overEquiv when applying the comparison; this exact equivalence preserves zero.

In a filtered colimit of sets, equality with zero at index zero is witnessed at a later index b. Apply Mathlib Types.FilteredColimit.isColimit_eq_iff' to the comparison cocone. The Hom diagram transition is precomposition with koszulOpenMap, which sends zero to zero. The augmentation compatibility supplied by represent-cohomology identifies the transitioned u_0 composed with φ with u_b composed with φ. Hence this last composite is zero. Move the shift back to the source. The empty family has a zero tail and kills every map immediately; the zero ring and zero target also satisfy the assertion.

from.place: Perfect-generation induction: supported affine object; filtered-colimit comparison step proving that maps from structure shifts are eventually killed by Koszul augmentations.

lean.statement:
theorem koszul_supported_augmentation_eventually_zero
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hU : U = ⨆ i : Fin r, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (hres : IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E.obj))
    (n : ℤ) (φ : (koszulOpenStructure A)⟦n⟧ ⟶ E.obj) :
    ∃ e : ℕ, (koszulOpenUnit A r f e)⟦n⟧' ≫ φ = 0
